name: saytype
description: Voice typing for every app in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and Kannada. Press a hotkey, speak, and formatted text appears at your cursor.

scripts.dev: node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c magenta,cyan "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.start: node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs && npm run build:renderer && electron .
scripts.pack: node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/fetch-whisper.cjs --platform linux --arch x64 && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SayType uses the microphone to transcribe your dictation.
